statement: Let S be separable, exact, and lower semicon- tinuous over X, and let H be sigma-unital. Suppose θ : S → H ⊗ K is a nuclear X-full homomorphism, meaning IdealH⊗K(θ(a)) = H(Ua) ⊗ K (a ∈ S+). Then its infinite repeat is weakly X-nuclear and absorbs every weakly X-nuclear representation on the standard module, by unitary equivalences with compact errors tending to zero on each input.
